result:
1. **Security (inbox/settings IDOR):** `src/lib/permissions.ts` — `notification:read`/`notification:manage` no longer grant by role (viewer rank is the floor, so every role passed before); added an `OWNERSHIP_ONLY` gate so only the resource's own recipient (or platform staff) is ever granted. `src/server/repositories/notification-repository.ts` — `markRead` now also filters by `recipientId`, closing the IDOR where any notification id could be marked read regardless of owner.
2. **"Mark all read" clearing everyone's alerts:** fixed `markAllRead` in the same repo file to filter by `recipientId` instead of the whole org.
3. **Broken links:** `notification-service.ts` and `search-service.ts` now resolve real app paths (`/org/projects/project/issues/number`, `/org/projects/project`, `/org/settings/members`, `/org/settings/billing`) by looking up org/project/issue slugs and numbers, instead of bare `/issues/{id}` style paths that don't match any route. Digest links inherit this fix automatically since they copy the notification's `href`.
4. **Owner not told about new members:** `member.joined` handler now notifies `org.ownerId` instead of the joiner.
5. **Status changes not notifying assignee:** added an `issue.status_changed` subscriber that notifies the assignee (skipped if unassigned; self-changes are filtered by `notify()`'s actor check).
6. **No alert when assigned at creation:** added an `issue.created` subscriber that sends the same `issue_assigned` notification when the issue is created with an assignee.
7. **Plan-limit refusals never notifying the owner:** added `billing.limit_exceeded` emits at the five refusal sites (project, seat/invite, issue, attachment upload, webhook) that were previously throwing without emitting; added a `billing.limit_exceeded` subscriber that notifies `org.ownerId`, deduped per-resource via `findUnreadByHref` while unread; removed the periodic recount's own emit so it never produces an alert.
8. **Muted in-app alerts still showing in inbox:** `listNotifications` and `countUnread` now filter rows to those whose `channels` include `in_app`.
